current_law_hits.snippet: Executive Order No. 12071 | Ex. Ord. No. 12071, July 12, 1978, 43 F.R. 30259, which established the President’s Commission on Pension Policy and provided for its membership, functions, etc., was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 12379, § 1, Aug. 17, 1982, 47 F.R. 36099, formerly set out as a note under section 1013 of Title 5, Government Organization and Employees.
